notes.title: Server Downtime for Update Notice
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear Gigaslave Players,[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Hello,[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]We will be performing a server maintenance update starting at 10:00 AM China Time on September 5th, which will last for 1 hour.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]For players in the Eastern Time Zone (USA), this will be at 9:00 PM on September 4th, with a duration of 1 hour.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]After the game update is complete, GMs will distribute compensation CDK codes online![/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]The update content is as follows:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 has been updated with a new item: (Enhanced Ability Value Inheritance Item * 2 Usage Card). This item allows already enhanced weapons to inherit their ability values to any other weapon, including shields.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 now includes the new weapon HG2 (this weapon has the same performance as C18 but with increased ammunition capacity).[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 1 has added the new (Captain America Cosmetic Shield), which has the same performance as other shields in the game.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 2 now contains the Scar Starburst, a weapon that holds 5 more bullets than the regular Scar and features bullet explosion effects.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 2 has added the M200 Sniper Rifle, which has the same performance as the Barrett M95.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 now includes the new M40 Sniper Rifle, which has the same performance as the Barrett M95.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 has added an M4 Rifle, which has an extremely enhanced firing range compared to the original version.[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Box 3 now contains a new costume: (Red Scarf Rebel) with the following ability values:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Attack Power increased by 5%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Speed increased by 5%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Health increased by 7[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullet Speed increased by 4%[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Movement Speed increased by 6%[/b][/p][/*][/olist][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]Adjustments and Optimizations:[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]To reduce game crashes caused by memory overflow, we have reduced the maximum number of players to 10.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]To reduce tournament crashes, we have limited the maximum number of spectators to 10.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased tournament rewards.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]
[/b][/p][p][b]The following is the current top-up event:
::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::::[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 500 gold will receive "Little Flying Dragon". It has the same performance as the Owl and can be carried as a follower in the game. Other players can press Control+K or Control+L to toggle its display on or off.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 1000 gold will receive "AN94-GL". It has the same performance as the AN94 but with 5 additional bullets.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]From after the game maintenance update until September 13th, players who accumulate top-up amounts of 1500 gold will receive "L50 Interstellar Fantasy". It has the same performance as the original version but with 5 additional bullets and features bullet explosion effects.[/b][/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Server Maintenance Update Notice
notes.content:
[p]Dear Players of [i]Gigaslave[/i],[/p][p]
[/p][p]The game will undergo a server maintenance update from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM Eastern Time on August 15, 2025. The update contents are as follows:[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where Death Mode does not increase authorized experience points.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where teammates in the Underground Processing Plant can damage the box base.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of occasional game crashes during enhancement.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the loading time when joining a game is as long as 10-30 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of occasional game crashes when joining a game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where multiple clicks in the in-game store may result in purchasing multiple items due to delays.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where weapons such as M202 and HK147 have performance inconsistent with their descriptions and incorrect time display.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted and added daily mission rewards and completion conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 10,000 authorized experience points and drop rewards in PVE cooperative mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an in-game Honor Store system with a large number of items for players to redeem. Players can earn balance by accumulating in-game online time and zombie kill counts to purchase rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Added room passwords for cooperative mode, enabling access to cooperative mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the function to minimize the window by pressing the "N" key in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added generous rewards such as Level 40 A-grade supply boxes, champion titles, and gold coins to daily knockout matches and team matches, and adjusted the match map to "Death Warehouse S".[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p][b]New Cosmetics (Fashion):[/b][/p][p]
